strings.en: Chad

strings.zh: 哎？那个莫非是{NEWLINE}你的精灵图鉴？{CLEAR}你见过大木博士了？{SCROLL}哎？见过？！{NEWLINE}好厉害！好厉害！{SCROLL}我的梦想是想成为{NEWLINE}像大木博士那样{CLEAR}杰出的精灵博士。{SCROLL}有件事想拜托你⋯⋯{NEWLINE}能不能和我交换一下电话号码？{SCROLL}我们聊聊关于{NEWLINE}大木博士的话题吧！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Huh? Is that a Pokédex?{NEWLINE}Have you met Professor Oak?{SCROLL}Huh? You have?! Amazing! Amazing!{SCROLL}My dream is to become a great Pokémon{NEWLINE}professor like Professor Oak.{SCROLL}Can I ask you a favor...? Would{NEWLINE}you trade phone numbers with me?{SCROLL}Let’s talk about Professor Oak!{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 大木博士的精灵讲座！{NEWLINE}你肯定也在听吧！
strings.en: You must listen to Professor Oak’s{NEWLINE}Pokémon Talk, right?

strings.zh: 是吗⋯⋯好可惜啊⋯⋯{NEWLINE}我真想见见大木博士博士啊。
strings.en: Oh... I wish I had a chance to meet{NEWLINE}Professor Oak...

strings.zh: 能把你的电话号码告诉我吗？{SCROLL}我们聊聊关于{NEWLINE}大木博士的话题吧！{CLEAR}肯定会很有意思的。{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: May I please have your phone number?{SCROLL}We should chat about Professor{NEWLINE}Oak. It will be loads of fun! {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 哎？{NEWLINE}难道你在附近？{CLEAR}你就这么喜欢打电话？
strings.en: Huh?{NEWLINE}Wait, aren’t you nearby?{CLEAR}Do you like the phone that much?

strings.zh: 最近,我开始了对{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:10}的观察⋯⋯{SCROLL}通过仔细观察,{NEWLINE}以前一些很纠结的疑问{CLEAR}都能得到答案！{SCROLL}真想快点成为像大木博士{NEWLINE}那样的精灵博士啊。{SCROLL}下次再聊吧！
strings.en: I recently began observing wild{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:10}.{SCROLL}I’ve been learning all sorts of new{NEWLINE}things through my observations.{SCROLL}I wish I could become a Pokémon{NEWLINE}researcher like Professor Oak soon.{SCROLL}See you later!

strings.zh: 对了,{NEWLINE}不久前我总算把{CLEAR}{VAR:0100:11}给打败了。{SCROLL}因为我每天都学习新知识,{NEWLINE}所以成功也是理所当然的。{SCROLL}下次再聊吧！
strings.en: Oh yes, I managed to knock out a wild{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11} a while back.{SCROLL}Well, considering all the Pokémon{NEWLINE}studying I do every day,{CLEAR}it was inevitable.{SCROLL}See you later!

strings.zh: 对了,{NEWLINE}前段时间我在最后让{CLEAR}{VAR:0100:11}给逃掉了⋯⋯{SCROLL}我好想从正面去对{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}进行观察啊,{CLEAR}真是太可惜了⋯⋯{SCROLL}下次再见吧！
strings.en: Oh yes, I came close to catching{NEWLINE}a wild {VAR:0100:11}, but it got away.{SCROLL}For the longest time, I’ve been wanting{NEWLINE}to observe {VAR:0100:11}. Man...{SCROLL}See you later!{NEWLINE}

strings.zh: 你知道小绿吗？{SCROLL}就是大木博士的孙子,{NEWLINE}还当过精灵冠军呢！{CLEAR}他是个很厉害的训练师！{SCROLL}拜拜。
strings.en: Do you know Blue?{SCROLL}He’s Professor Oak’s grandson and a{NEWLINE}former Pokémon League Champion!{CLEAR}He’s one super Pokémon Trainer!{SCROLL}See you later!

strings.zh: 大木博士有个叫{NEWLINE}奈奈美的孙女⋯⋯{SCROLL}在她面前,无论是{NEWLINE}如何凶暴的精灵{CLEAR}都会变得老老实实！{SCROLL}再见啦。
strings.en: Professor Oak has a granddaughter{NEWLINE}named Daisy.{SCROLL}When she’s around, even the most{NEWLINE}ferocious Pokémon calm right down.{SCROLL}See you later!

strings.zh: 我们聊聊最近很红的空木博士吧！{SCROLL}从前他做过{NEWLINE}大木博士的助手！{SCROLL}啊！真的好羡慕他啊！{SCROLL}下次再聊吧。
strings.en: Everyone’s talking about{NEWLINE}Professor Elm.{SCROLL}He used to be an assistant to the great{NEWLINE}Professor Oak!{SCROLL}That is so cool! I envy him!{SCROLL}See you later!

strings.zh: 大木博士的梦想{NEWLINE}是要完成一份{CLEAR}完美的精灵图鉴！{SCROLL}你能当他实现梦想的助手,{NEWLINE}我真的好羡慕啊⋯⋯{SCROLL}好了,就聊到这吧。
strings.en: Professor Oak’s dream is to{NEWLINE}compile a comprehensive Pokédex.{SCROLL}I envy you for taking{NEWLINE}part in that project...{SCROLL}See you later!

strings.zh: 制球达人岩铁先生{SCROLL}在很早以前就是{NEWLINE}大木博士的老相识了！{SCROLL}强人的周围{NEWLINE}总是不缺强人！{SCROLL}再见啦。
strings.en: Do you know Kurt, the{NEWLINE}Poké Ball creator?{SCROLL}He and Professor Oak go back{NEWLINE}a long way. I guess great{CLEAR}people attract one another!{SCROLL}See you later!

strings.zh: 精灵联盟是所有{NEWLINE}向往成为精灵冠军的{CLEAR}训练师的圣地！{SCROLL}大木博士为{NEWLINE}精灵联盟的总部{CLEAR}提供了各种各样的建议！{SCROLL}真是个厉害的人物啊！{SCROLL}再见啦。
strings.en: The Pokémon League is the great{NEWLINE}gathering place for all Trainers who{CLEAR}wish to become the Champion.{SCROLL}Professor Oak acts as an advisor to{NEWLINE}the Pokémon League’s headquarters.{SCROLL}He really is a great man.{SCROLL}See you later!

strings.zh: 大木博士的精灵讲座{NEWLINE}是一档非常具有人气的广播节目！{SCROLL}但大木博士{NEWLINE}一开始是准备回绝的！{SCROLL}不过各地纷纷发来请求,{NEWLINE}胡桃小姐也是不依不饶,{CLEAR}所以博士才上了节目！{CLEAR}真得好好谢谢胡桃小姐啊！{SCROLL}再见啦。
strings.en: Professor Oak’s Pokémon Talk is a{NEWLINE}popular radio show, right?{SCROLL}Did you know that he was going to turn{NEWLINE}down the show at first?{SCROLL}But Mary’s energy and persistence wore{NEWLINE}him down.{CLEAR}So we have Mary to thank for it!{SCROLL}See you later!

strings.zh: 博士博士从前{NEWLINE}也是一名精灵训练师。{SCROLL}但是他比起对战,{NEWLINE}更喜欢精灵{CLEAR}本身的研究。{SCROLL}于是他放弃了训练师这行,{NEWLINE}潜心进行研究。{SCROLL}再见啦。
strings.en: Professor Oak used to be a Trainer a{NEWLINE}long time ago.{SCROLL}But rather than battling, he found{NEWLINE}Pokémon themselves to be interesting.{SCROLL}So he abandoned his training to focus{NEWLINE}on becoming a researcher.{SCROLL}See you later!

strings.zh: 大木博士有位叫{NEWLINE}奈奈美的孙女。{SCROLL}她每天下午３点开始{NEWLINE}有１个小时的下午茶时间！{SCROLL}真想和她一起喝茶,{NEWLINE}听听关于{CLEAR}大木博士的话题啊⋯⋯{SCROLL}再见。
strings.en: Professor Oak has a granddaughter{NEWLINE}named Daisy.{SCROLL}She has tea every day for an hour from{NEWLINE}three in the afternoon.{SCROLL}I wish I could join her for tea and chat{NEWLINE}about Professor Oak.{SCROLL}See you later!

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{NEWLINE}大木博士在年轻的时候{CLEAR}曾环游过世界。{SCROLL}在旅途中能在不知不觉中{NEWLINE}学到很多关于精灵的知识。{SCROLL}好羡慕他啊⋯⋯{NEWLINE}我也想到各地去旅行,{CLEAR}学习各种知识⋯⋯{SCROLL}再见啦。
strings.en: Did you know?{NEWLINE}Professor Oak traveled all over the{CLEAR}world when he was young.{SCROLL}While traveling, he must’ve learned{NEWLINE}about Pokémon naturally.{SCROLL}I envy him... I’d like to travel and{NEWLINE}learn about things, too...{SCROLL}See you later!

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{NEWLINE}大木博士在年轻的时候{CLEAR}曾环游过世界。{SCROLL}在旅途中能在不知不觉中{NEWLINE}学到很多关于精灵的知识。{SCROLL}好羡慕他啊⋯⋯{NEWLINE}我也想到各地去旅行,{CLEAR}学习各种知识⋯⋯{SCROLL}再见啦。
strings.en: Did you know?{NEWLINE}Professor Oak traveled all over the{CLEAR}world when he was young.{SCROLL}While traveling, he must’ve learned{NEWLINE}about Pokémon naturally.{SCROLL}I envy him... I’d like to travel and{NEWLINE}learn about things, too...{SCROLL}See you later!

strings.zh: 喂,和我来场对战怎么样？{NEWLINE}长时间不进行对战的话,{CLEAR}对战的感觉会慢慢变迟钝的！{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}等你,{NEWLINE}到了就直接来找我吧。
strings.en: Want to battle?{SCROLL}I have to battle every so often to{NEWLINE}avoid getting rusty.{SCROLL}I’ll be on {VAR:0104:3}!

strings.zh: 喂喂,你还记得{NEWLINE}和我对战的约定吗？{SCROLL}地点是在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}我等你,快点来。
strings.en: Do you remember about our battle?{SCROLL}The place is {VAR:0104:3}.{NEWLINE}Hurry over--I’m waiting.

strings.zh: 学习各种精灵的知识,{NEWLINE}长大了就能成为{CLEAR}大木博士的助手了！
strings.en: I’m going to study all about{NEWLINE}Pokémon so that Professor{CLEAR}Oak will make me his assistant!
